items.title: Airbnb’s CEO Says AI Is the Best Thing That Ever Happened to His Company. Here’s Why
items.summary: Brian Chesky made a bold claim at Goldman Sachs this week, comparing AI to electricity and calling it the best thing to ever happen to Airbnb. The real question is whether his numbers actually back that up or whether the growth gap he is touting will hold against a peer group running the exact same playbook.
